people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall purge the innocent blood from Israel that it may go well with you.
translations.bsb: You must show him no pity. You are to purge from Israel the guilt of shedding innocent blood, that it may go well with you.
translations.kjv: Thine eye shall not pity him, but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well
